records.jp: じゃあ、脚本を元に読み合わせしていきましょうか。<CR>ひとまずは今言った配役で内容を確認していく感じで
records.en_original: Right, now that we all have our scripts, let's do a read-through to get into our roles a little more.
records.en_auxiliary: Right, now that we all have our scripts, let's do a read-through to get into our roles a little more.
records.en: Then let's do a read-through based on the script.<CR>For now, we'll check the contents using the roles we just assigned.

records.jp: それでは
records.en_original: All right then.
records.en_auxiliary: All right then.
records.en: All right then.

records.jp: 昔々あるところに――
records.en_original: Once upon a time...
records.en_auxiliary: Once upon a time...
records.en: Once upon a time...

records.jp: この薬を飲めばいいの？　うっ、うわあああああ
records.en_original: I just need to drink this potion? Gulp. Ahhhh!
records.en_auxiliary: I just need to drink this potion? *Gulp* ...Ahhhh!
records.en: Do I just drink this medicine? Ugh... Aaaaaah!

records.jp: 人魚姫の得た足は、ミイラのように崩れた足でした
records.en_original: The Little Mermaid's new legs were as shriveled as a mummy.
records.en_auxiliary: The Little Mermaid's new legs were as shriveled as a mummy.
records.en: The legs the Little Mermaid received were crumbling like a mummy's.

records.jp: うまく歩けず、地面を這う人魚姫。しかし、あまりの醜さに<CR>王子だけでなく、すべての人から避けられてしまいます
records.en_original: Unable to walk, all she could do was crawl. And the prince and all his retainers were repulsed by the sight of her.
records.en_auxiliary: Unable to walk, all she could do was crawl. And the prince and all his retainers were repulsed by the sight of her.
records.en: Unable to walk, the Little Mermaid crawled along the ground.<CR>But she was so hideous that everyone—not only the prince—shunned her.

records.jp: こ、このままじゃ死んでしまう……。誰か……
records.en_original: D-Don't leave me to die... Someone, please...
records.en_auxiliary: D-don't leave me to die... Someone, please...
records.en: A-At this rate, I'll die... Someone...

records.jp: しかも、声を失った人魚姫は、誰にも思いを伝えられません。<CR>そのまま人魚姫は死んでしまって――
records.en_original: Her voice stolen, the mermaid was unable to say these words. After what seemed an eternity, she breathed her last--
records.en_auxiliary: Her voice stolen, the mermaid was unable to say these words. After what seemed an eternity, she breathed her last—
records.en: And because the Little Mermaid had lost her voice, she could not convey her feelings to anyone.<CR>And so, the Little Mermaid died—

records.jp: ……ってさっきから何なのこの脚本！<CR>全然原作と違うよ！
records.en_original: ...What's wrong with this script!? It's nothing like the original!
records.en_auxiliary: ...What's wrong with this script?! It's nothing like the original!
records.en: ...What is with this script!?<CR>It's nothing like the original story!

records.jp: しかも、こんな内容……
records.en_original: And the plot's just...
records.en_auxiliary: And the plot's just...
records.en: And the plot's just...

records.jp: これ……
records.en_auxiliary: This is...
records.en: This...

records.jp: なにこの脚本？
records.en_original: What is this script?
records.en_auxiliary: What is this script?
records.en: What is this script?

records.jp: ひどい！　ホント何なのこの内容？
records.en_original: It's garbage! Is this some kind of sick joke!?
records.en_auxiliary: It's awful! Is this some kind of sick joke?!
records.en: This is awful! Seriously, what is this story!?

records.jp: 脚本書いたのって、放送部の……誰だっけ？
records.en_original: Who in the broadcasting club wrote this?
records.en_auxiliary: Who in the broadcasting club wrote this?
records.en: Who in the broadcasting club wrote this?

records.jp: たしか一之瀬さんじゃなかった？
records.en_original: Wasn't it Ichinose?
records.en_auxiliary: Wasn't it Ichinose?
records.en: Wasn't it Ichinose-san?

records.jp: でも量があるし、一人でやったわけじゃないでしょ？
records.en_original: It's too long to have been just her.
records.en_auxiliary: It's too long to have been just her.
records.en: But there's so much of it. She couldn't have done it alone, right?

records.jp: そういえば森川さんがアドバイスしていなかったっけ……？
records.en_original: Didn't Morikawa help, too?
records.en_auxiliary: Didn't Morikawa help, too?
records.en: Didn't Morikawa-san help, too?

records.jp: え、本当？
records.en_original: What, really?
records.en_auxiliary: What, really?
records.en: What, really?

records.jp: 二人とも……今日はいないわね
records.en_original: Both of them...are absent today.
records.en_auxiliary: Both of them...are absent today.
records.en: Both of them...are absent today.

records.jp: あ……あぁ……
records.en_original: *sniffle*... No...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sniffle* No...
records.en: Ah... Aah...

records.jp: （うそ……更紗と亜子が……？　なんで……どうして？）
records.en_original: (No way... Could Sarasa and Ako really have...? Why?)
records.en_auxiliary: (No way... Could Sarasa and Ako really have...? Why?)
records.en: (No way... Could Sarasa and Ako really have...? Why?)

records.jp: 誰がやったのか知らないけど、許せないわね
records.en_original: I don't know who did it, but this is inexcusable.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know who did it, but this is inexcusable.
records.en: I don't know who did it, but this is inexcusable.

records.jp: 白井さんはバレエのケガのことで本当に傷ついているのに<CR>こんな悪ふざけの材料に使うなんて
records.en_original: Shirai's suffering from her ballet injury. How could someone turn this into a joke?
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai's suffering from her ballet injury. How could someone turn this into a joke?
records.en: Shirai-san is deeply hurt over her ballet injury.<CR>How could someone use that as material for a cruel joke?

records.jp: 麻央……
records.en_original: Mao...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao...
records.en: Mao...

records.jp: この中に犯人がいるの？　いるなら名乗り出なさい！
records.en_original: I swear, if it was any of you... Identify yourself!
records.en_auxiliary: I swear, if it was any of you... Identify yourself!
records.en: Is the culprit among us? If you are, come forward!

records.jp: いつまでこんな茶番を続けるつもり？
records.en_original: You really are quite the actor. How long will you keep thus up?
records.en_auxiliary: You really are quite the actor. How long do you plan to keep this up?
records.en: How long do you plan to keep up this farce?

records.jp: ライム……？　それにユズも
records.en_original: Lime? Yuzu?
records.en_auxiliary: Lime? Yuzu?
records.en: Lime? Yuzu?

records.jp: クラスのみんなは、あなたの引き立て役でも操り人形でもないよ
records.en_original: The girls in this class aren't your puppets, you know.
records.en_auxiliary: The girls in this class aren't your puppets, you know.
records.en: The girls in this class aren't here to make you look good, and they aren't your puppets.

records.jp: な、なんの話？
records.en_original: Wh-What are you talking about?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you talking about?
records.en: Wh-What are you talking about?

records.jp: 全部あなたが仕組んだことでしょ？<CR>あなたが主役になりたくて、周りの注目を浴びたくてやったこと
records.en_original: You had it all planned out, didn’t you? You nearly got away with stealing the spotlight and the lead role.
records.en_auxiliary: You planned this entire thing, didn't you? You wanted to steal the spotlight and the lead role.
records.en: You planned all of this, didn't you?<CR>You wanted the lead role and everyone's attention.

records.jp: ううん、今回の話だけじゃない。<CR>盗難の件も、その前に起こったたくさんの事件も全部、全部
records.en_original: And it's not just this. You've been pulling the strings in the thefts and all the other incidents up until now.
records.en_auxiliary: And it's not just this. You've been pulling the strings in the thefts and all the other incidents up until now.
records.en: No, it isn't only this.<CR>The thefts, and all the incidents before them—everything.

records.jp: 自分は表に出ないまま、<CR>人の弱みや軋轢を利用して事件を起こしていた
records.en_original: You were too smart to do anything yourself, but you took advantage of others' weaknesses to make them happen.
records.en_auxiliary: You were too smart to do anything yourself, but you took advantage of others' weaknesses to make them happen.
records.en: You stayed out of sight while using people's weaknesses and conflicts<CR>to cause all those incidents.

records.jp: 言うことを聞かないとクラスにいられなくなる、<CR>みんなにあなたの弱みをバラしちゃうぞって
records.en_original: If any girl tried to oppose you, you threatened to expose their weaknesses to the entire class.
records.en_auxiliary: If any girl tried to oppose you, you threatened to expose their weaknesses to the entire class.
records.en: You told them that if they didn't obey, they wouldn't be able to stay in the class,<CR>and that you'd expose their weaknesses to everyone.

records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?
records.en: What...?

records.jp: い、いきなり何を言い出すのよ！
records.en_original: H-How could you say such a thing!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you saying?
records.en: Wh-What are you talking about all of a sudden!?

records.jp: 作り話も大概にしてほしいわ。<CR>そんなこと言って、ホントは全部あなたがやったんじゃないの！？
records.en_original: Stop making things up. I bet you're accusing me because you're the one doing all this!
records.en_auxiliary: Stop making things up. I bet you're accusing me because you're the one doing all this!
records.en: Enough of your lies.<CR>Aren't you accusing me because you're the one who did all of this!?

records.jp: 白井さん、信じて！<CR>そんなこと、私がするわけないじゃない！
records.en_original: Shirai, you have to believe me! I would never do anything like that!
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai, you have to believe me! I would never do anything like that!
records.en: Shirai-san, believe me!<CR>I would never do anything like that!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina!
records.en: Hina-chan!

records.jp: （あのね、ライムも、ううん、ライムのほうがずっと<CR>ヒナちゃんのことを大切に思ってるの。必死に頑張ってるの）
records.en_original: (Lime really does care about you; probably more than you know. She's trying desperately to help you through this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Lime really does care about you—probably more than you know. She's trying desperately to help you through this.)
records.en: (Listen, Lime cares about you too—no, far more than I do, Hina-chan.<CR>She's doing everything she can.)

records.jp: 白井さん？
records.en_original: Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai?
records.en: Shirai-san?

records.jp: ……ごめん。私はライムのことを疑えない
records.en_original: ...Sorry. If Lime says so, I have to believe her.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sorry. If Lime says so, I believe her.
records.en: ...I'm sorry. I can't doubt Lime.

records.jp: 確かにライムはよくわからない子だよ。<CR>時々、すごく怖く感じることもある
records.en_original: Yes, she can be a bit odd. Sometimes, I'm almost scared of her.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, she can be a bit of an enigma. Sometimes, I'm almost scared of her.
records.en: Lime certainly is hard to understand.<CR>Sometimes, she even scares me.

records.jp: でも、私を傷つけるようなことだけはしないと思うの。<CR>だから……
records.en_original: But still, I don't think she would ever try to hurt me. That's why...
records.en_auxiliary: But still, I don't think she would ever try to hurt me. That's why...
records.en: But I don't think she would ever do anything to hurt me.<CR>That's why...

records.jp: だから私はライムを信じるよ
records.en_original: That's why I believe her.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I believe her.
records.en: That's why I believe her.

records.jp: 白井さん……
records.en_original: Shirai, please...
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai, please...
records.en: Shirai-san, please...

records.jp: ところで……麻央？<CR>なんであなた、私がバレエでケガしたことを知ってるの？
records.en_original: And Mao... How do you know that I got injured during ballet?
records.en_auxiliary: And Mao... How do you know that I got injured during ballet?
records.en: By the way... Mao,<CR>how did you know I was injured doing ballet?

records.jp: ？　だ、だって白井さんが足を怪我してるってみんなが言うから
records.en_original: Huh? Well... B-Because everyone says you injured your leg.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Well... B-because everyone says you injured your leg.
records.en: Huh? B-Because everyone said you'd hurt your leg.

records.jp: うん……確かに私は足を怪我してるし、<CR>他の子たちにもそう言われた
records.en_original: ...It's true that I injured my leg, yes, and the other girls do know that...
records.en_auxiliary: ...It's true that I injured my leg, yes, and the other girls do know that...
records.en: ...It's true that I injured my leg,<CR>and the other girls have said as much.

records.jp: でも、バレエで怪我したなんて、誰からも言われてないよ？
records.en_original: But nobody's said anything about my injury being related to ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: But nobody's said anything about my injury being related to ballet.
records.en: But nobody's said anything about my injury being related to ballet.

records.jp: ……やれやれ、私も詰めが甘いわね
records.en_original: ...Good grief. Guess I slipped up.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Good grief. Guess I slipped up.
records.en: ...Good grief. Guess I slipped up.

records.jp: 麻央？
records.en_original: Mao?
records.en_auxiliary: Mao?
records.en: Mao?

records.jp: そうよ。ご指摘どおり、私が仕組んだこと。脚本のすり替えも、<CR>この前あなたが解決した盗難事件も全部、全部ね
records.en_original: You're right. I planned this all out. I secretly switched the script, and I'm behind those thefts you "solved".
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. I planned this all out. I secretly switched the script, and I'm behind those thefts you "solved."
records.en: You're right. I was behind all of it—switching the script,<CR>and the thefts you "solved" the other day. Everything.

records.jp: で？　それがどうかしたの？
records.en_original: So what? What will you do?
records.en_auxiliary: So what? What will you do?
records.en: So? What's the problem?

records.jp: ど、どうかしたのって……<CR>悪巧みがバレたからって開き直る気！？
records.en_original: S-So what...? Are you getting cocky now that all your schemes have been exposed!?
records.en_auxiliary: S-so what...? Are you getting cocky now that all your schemes have been exposed?!
records.en: Wh-What do you mean, 'what's the problem'!?<CR>Are you really going to stand there and act defiant now that your scheme's been exposed!?

records.jp: 悪巧み、悪巧みね、……はっ
records.en_original: My schemes... My schemes...? Ha!
records.en_auxiliary: My schemes... My schemes...? Ha!
records.en: My schemes... My schemes...? Ha!

records.jp: ねぇ、あなた中学の時、万引きで補導されてたわよね？<CR>受験のストレスで魔が差した、とか言い訳してたけど
records.en_original: You had to receive special counseling after shoplifting in junior high, right? You said you did it because of "stress."
records.en_auxiliary: You had to receive special counseling after shoplifting in junior high, right? You said you did it because of stress from entrance exams.
records.en: You were picked up by the police for shoplifting in middle school, weren't you?<CR>You claimed entrance-exam stress made you lose your head.

records.jp: でも、ちょっとむしゃくしゃしたから、<CR>なんて理由で子供の頃から何度も事件を起こしてたわよねぇ
records.en_original: But the thing is, you've done the same thing whenever you were frustrated since you were little.
records.en_auxiliary: But the thing is, you've done the same thing whenever you were frustrated since you were little.
records.en: But you'd been causing trouble like that since childhood<CR>whenever you got frustrated, hadn't you?

records.jp: 星ノ宮に入学した後も、周りと馴染めなくて苛々してたでしょ？
records.en_original: And when you arrived at this school, you were frustrated when you didn't fit in, right?
records.en_auxiliary: And when you arrived at this school, you were frustrated when you didn't fit in, right?
records.en: And when you arrived at this school, you were frustrated when you didn't fit in, right?

records.jp: 私が『校内でお金を調達しろ』と言わなかったら、<CR>どうなってたかしら
records.en_original: If I hadn't told you, "get me cash from inside the school," who knows what incidents you might've caused.
records.en_auxiliary: If I hadn't told you, "Get me cash from inside the school," who knows what incidents you might've caused.
records.en: What do you think would've happened<CR>if I hadn't told you to raise money inside the school?

records.jp: 学内の事件なら内々に収められるかもだけど、<CR>外で同じことをやったら今度こそ新聞沙汰になってたかもねぇ
records.en_original: Imagine what would've happened if you were caught stealing outside of school. It could've been headline news.
records.en_auxiliary: Imagine what would've happened if you were caught stealing outside of school. It could've been headline news.
records.en: An incident on school grounds might have been handled quietly,<CR>but if you'd done the same thing outside, it could have made the papers this time.

records.jp: ……わ、私は
学校のイメージも悪くなって、クラスのみんなが<CR>外で歩きづらくなっていたかも
records.en_original: Now, that would've been a nasty mark on the school's reputation. An embarrassment to all of us in this class.
records.en_auxiliary: Now, that would've been a nasty mark on the school's reputation. An embarrassment to all of us in this class.
records.en: The school's reputation might have suffered,<CR>and everyone in the class might have been ashamed to show their faces in public.

records.jp: あと、あなた
records.en_original: And you.
records.en_auxiliary: And you.
records.en: And you.

records.jp: 自分が仲間外れにされたくないからって、<CR>いつも弱い者探しをしてるわよね
records.en_original: You're always looking for people to pick on because you're scared of being picked on yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always looking for people to pick on because you're scared of being picked on yourself.
records.en: You're always looking for someone weaker<CR>because you don't want to be excluded yourself.

records.jp: あの子がむかつく、みんなであの子を攻撃しようって
records.en_original: You're always talking about who pisses you off, who should be a target of bullying next.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always talking about who pisses you off, who should be a target of bullying next.
records.en: 'That girl gets on my nerves. Let's all gang up on her.'

records.jp: それで昔、同級生を一人、登校拒否にしちゃったんだっけ？<CR>自殺未遂とか起きて大変だったって聞いたけど
records.en_original: I heard you once bullied a classmade so badly that they attempted suicide and couldn't come to school anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: And didn't you once bully a classmate so badly that they stopped coming to school? I heard they even attempted suicide.
records.en: Didn't you once bully a classmate until she stopped coming to school?<CR>I heard it became a huge mess after she attempted suicide.

records.jp: な、なんでそのことを……
records.en_original: How? How do you know that...?
records.en_auxiliary: How? How do you know that...?
records.en: How? How do you know that...?

records.jp: だから事件にならない程度のオモチャを時々与えてあげたでしょ？<CR>少しくらいいじめてもヘコまない相手や、からかいやすい教師を
records.en_original: So I gave you some easy prey every now and then. Girls who could take a bit of bullying, or even a vulnerable teacher.
records.en_auxiliary: So I gave you some easy prey every now and then. Girls who could take a bit of bullying, or even a vulnerable teacher.
records.en: So every now and then, I gave you toys that wouldn't cause a serious incident.<CR>Targets who wouldn't be crushed by a little bullying, or teachers who were easy to tease.

records.jp: そうやって私が一生懸命、火消しやガス抜きをしてるのに<CR>どこかの誰かさんが、正義漢ぶっていろいろ掻き回してくれるから
records.en_original: I've been doing my best to help you depressurize, but then Little Miss Justice comes stirring things up around here.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been doing my best to help you depressurize, but then Little Miss Justice comes stirring things up around here.
records.en: I've been working so hard to put out fires and relieve the pressure,<CR>but a certain someone keeps playing the hero and stirring everything up.

records.jp: そう、思い知らせてあげようと思ったのよ。<CR>そのお気楽な仮面をむしりとってやろうって
records.en_original: So that's why I decided to teach you a little lesson. <CR>I couldn't wait to rip off your happy-go-lucky mask.
records.en_auxiliary: So that's why I decided to teach you a little lesson.<CR>I couldn't wait to rip off your happy-go-lucky mask.
records.en: That's right. I decided to teach you a lesson.<CR>I was going to tear off that carefree mask of yours.

records.jp: 随分怪我のことを気にしてるみたいだから、<CR>噂で流せば効果的かなと思ったんだけど
records.en_original: I could tell your injury bothered you, so I thought spreading gossip about it would be a fine place to start.
records.en_auxiliary: I could tell your injury bothered you, so I thought spreading gossip about it would be a fine place to start.
records.en: I could tell how much your injury bothered you,<CR>so I thought spreading rumors about it would be effective.

records.jp: なかなか意図したように情報は広まってくれないものね。<CR>残念だわ
records.en_original: Unfortunately, it didn't catch on like I hoped it would. What a shame.
records.en_auxiliary: Unfortunately, it didn't catch on like I hoped it would. What a shame.
records.en: Information doesn't spread quite as easily as you'd expect.<CR>What a shame.

records.jp: そ、そんな理由で人の心をもてあそんでたの
records.en_original: I-Is that why you've been messing around with these girls' emotions?
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that why you've been messing around with these girls' emotions?
records.en: Y-You toyed with people's hearts for a reason like that?

records.jp: もてあそんでなんかいないわよ。さっきの話、聞いたでしょ？
records.en_original: If you think I've just been messing around, you haven't been paying attention. Weren't you listening?
records.en_auxiliary: If you think I've just been messing around, you haven't been paying attention. Weren't you listening?
records.en: I wasn't toying with anyone. You heard what I just said, didn't you?

records.jp: その子たちは私がフォローしてなかったら<CR>もっと大事件を起こしてたって
records.en_original: If I hadn't been providing an outlet for these girls, they would've caused much bigger problems.
records.en_auxiliary: If I hadn't been providing an outlet for these girls, they would've caused much bigger problems.
records.en: Those girls would have caused much bigger incidents<CR>if I hadn't been keeping them in check.

records.jp: 私は、みんなが平和な学園生活を送れるよう腐心してただけよ
records.en_original: I'm only going through all this trouble so that we can all live in peace.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm only going through all this trouble so that we can all live in peace.
records.en: I'm only going through all this trouble so that we can all live in peace.

records.jp: みんながお互いを疑って、ギスギスした気持ちになって、<CR>誰かを吊し上げるようなクラスが平和？　笑わせないで
records.en_original: How can you call all the suspicion and friction in this class "living in peace"? Don't make me laugh.
records.en_auxiliary: How can you call all the suspicion and friction in this class "living in peace"? Don't make me laugh.
records.en: You call a class where everyone suspects one another, feels constantly on edge,<CR>and singles someone out for punishment "peaceful"? Don't make me laugh.

records.jp: 誰も怪我していない、警察沙汰にもなっていない。親も先生も<CR>喜んでる。これが平和じゃなかったらいったいなんだっていうの？
records.en_original: Nobody's injured and the police aren't involved. Our teachers and parents seem to be happy. This IS peace!
records.en_auxiliary: Nobody's injured and the police aren't involved. Our teachers and parents seem to be happy. This IS peace!
records.en: No one has been hurt, and the police haven't become involved.<CR>The parents and teachers are happy. If that isn't peace, then what is?

records.jp: ダミー
みんなの心は全然平和じゃないよ
records.en_original: There's no peace in our hearts.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no peace in our hearts.
records.en: There's no peace in our hearts.

records.jp: 心なんて……！　馬鹿じゃないの？
records.en_original: Our hearts?! Are you kidding me right now?
records.en_auxiliary: "Our hearts"? Are you kidding me right now?
records.en: Our hearts?! Are you kidding me right now?

records.jp: みんな自分だけが大事で<CR>他人のことなんかどうでもいいんだから
records.en_original: Not one person here cares anybody but themselves. Not one person on earth!
records.en_auxiliary: Not one person here cares about anybody but themselves. Not one person on Earth!
records.en: Everyone only cares about themselves.<CR>They couldn't care less about anyone else.

records.jp: そういう連中を一つの箱に入れて上手くやらせようと思ったら、<CR>悪意や敵意をコントロールしてバランスを取っていくしかない
records.en_original: If you force everyone into a box and want them to get along, you HAVE to balance out the hate and pressure.
records.en_auxiliary: If you force everyone into a box and want them to get along, you have to balance out the hate and pressure.
records.en: If you're going to put people like that in one box and make them get along,<CR>you have no choice but to control their malice and hostility to keep the balance.

records.jp: 私は『よく知ってる』んだから
records.en_original: I know that far too well.
records.en_auxiliary: I know that far too well.
records.en: I know that all too well.

records.jp: で、でも別にこんなやり方することないでしょ！<CR>せっかくみんなで一生懸命、舞台の準備をしてたのに！
records.en_original: But still, that's no excuse for...all of this! We were all working so hard to prepare for the play!
records.en_auxiliary: But still, that's no excuse for...all of this! We were all working so hard to prepare for the play!
records.en: B-But you didn't have to do it this way!<CR>Everyone worked so hard preparing for the play!

records.jp: 舞台？　こんなママゴトみたいな行事、どうだっていいじゃない？<CR>所詮は素人の遊び、自己満足でしょ
records.en_original: The play. Who cares? It's nothing but childish ego stroking.
records.en_auxiliary: The play? Who cares? It's nothing but childish ego stroking.
records.en: A play? Who cares about a childish make-believe event like this?<CR>It's only amateurs playing around to satisfy themselves.

records.jp: それとも何？　何か思い入れでもあったの？　<CR>人魚姫なんて、子供っぽい演目に
records.en_original: Or do you really feel some sort of attachment to something as kiddy as The Little Mermaid?
records.en_auxiliary: Or do you really feel some sort of attachment to something as kiddy as The Little Mermaid?
records.en: Or what? Did it mean something special to you?<CR>A childish production like The Little Mermaid?

records.jp: とにかく、私のことはいいからみんなに謝って
records.en_original: It doesn't matter what you've done to me, but you owe everyone else here an apology.
records.en_auxiliary: It doesn't matter what you've done to me, but you owe everyone else here an apology.
records.en: Anyway, forget about me and apologize to everyone.

records.jp: ひどいことしてごめん、<CR>文化祭の準備を台なしにして悪かったって
records.en_original: Apologize for the terrible things you did, and for messing with preparations for the school festival.
records.en_auxiliary: Apologize for the terrible things you did, and for messing with preparations for the culture festival.
records.en: Tell them you're sorry for doing something so awful,<CR>and for ruining the preparations for the school festival.

records.jp: ……まだ、そんなキレイごとを
records.en_original: ...Look at you, trying to sweep everything under the rug again.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Look at you, trying to act like a saint with your words.
records.en: ...Still spouting those pretty little platitudes.

records.jp: やっぱり、あなたのこと嫌いだわ。本当にむかつく。<CR>捻り潰してやりたい
records.en_original: God, I can't stand you. Just looking at you pisses me off. I just want to crush you beneath my heel!
records.en_auxiliary: God, I can't stand you. Just looking at you pisses me off. I just want to crush you beneath my heel!
records.en: I really do hate you. You infuriate me.<CR>I want to crush you.

records.jp: 麻央
records.en_original: Mao!?
records.en_auxiliary: Mao?!
records.en: Mao!?

records.jp: 嫌い……嫌い……嫌い、嫌い、嫌い、<CR>嫌い、嫌い、嫌い、嫌い、嫌い！
records.en_original: I hate you... HATE you. HATE YOU, HATE YOU, HATE YOU, HATEYOUHATEYOUHATEYOUHATEYOU!
records.en_auxiliary: I hate you... hate you... HATE YOU... HATE YOU, HATE YOU, HATEYOUHATEYOU!!
records.en: I hate you... I hate you... I hate you, hate you, hate you,<CR>hate you, hate you, hate you, hate you, HATE YOU!

records.jp: 『消えてしまえ』
records.en_original: Just disappear.
records.en_auxiliary: Just disappear.
records.en: Just disappear.

records.jp: な、なにこれ！？
records.en_original: W-What now!?
records.en_auxiliary: W-what's happening?!
records.en: W-What is this!?

records.jp: 暴走……じゃない！　引き込まれる！
records.en_original: Is she going rampant? ...No, it's something else! We're getting pulled in!
records.en_auxiliary: Is she going rampant? ...No, it's something else! We're getting pulled in!
records.en: Is she going rampant? ...No, it's something else! We're getting pulled in!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Hinaaaaaaa!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina!
records.en: Hina-chan!

records.jp: ぐっ！
records.en_original: Ahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh!
records.en: Ghk!
